title: Procedural Memory and Cognitive Loop Closure
subtitle: Cognitive loop closure compiles repeated reasoning into verified parameterized tools and procedural memory.

display.problem: Repeated reasoning trajectories should not be improvised forever when they can become verified procedures or tools.
display.insufficient: Agents waste cognition and introduce inconsistency when recurring workflows are repeatedly reconstructed from scratch.

mechanism.label: Freeze target task family
mechanism.detail: Freeze the target task family, intended consumers… success criteria, and non-claims before mining traces.

mechanism.label: Complete eligible trace universe
mechanism.detail: Inventory the complete eligible trace universe… model, tool, effect, evaluator, and outcome identities.

mechanism.label: Separate semantic facts episodic
mechanism.detail: Separate semantic facts, episodic observations, procedural traces… so one memory domain cannot launder another.

mechanism.label: Verify source effect receipts
mechanism.detail: Verify source and effect receipts against artifact… any trace is eligible for learning.

failures: Anecdote closure promotes one elegant or lucky trace without a comparable cluster.
Similarity laundering clusters superficially similar traces… authority, environments, effects, or outcomes differ.
Memory-domain laundering turns facts, summaries, policies… intended actions into observed procedural evidence.
Receipt laundering accepts declared inputs, tool… checking artifact and runtime reality.
proof_targets: A reachable procedure lifecycle preserves exact procedure… retirement without assigning support or external effects.
Missing comparable traces, negative examples, source/effect receipts… blocks lifecycle progress or routes to quarantine.
No declared source, intended action, or success… independently observed source and effect receipts.
